Babar Azam Appointed Pakistan Test Captain Again

Babar Azam has been reappointed as the captain of the Pakistan Test cricket team. This decision by the Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB) sees Shan Masood removed from the captaincy. The announcement was made alongside the selection of the Pakistan squad for upcoming tours to the West Indies and England.
